title:
Beyond using standards,
we help build them
lead: Wicked Storm is a founding board member of 1EdTech Korea, the Korean organization of the global EdTech standards consortium 1EdTech, and is active as a 1EdTech Contributing Member. We have applied xAPI, Caliper, and 1EdTech CASE to our products and projects.

map.title: Standards map
map.lead: The 1EdTech CASE framework of curricula, achievement standards, and competencies stands on its own as the foundation. On top of it, we collect learning data, issue credentials for achievements, and connect with other systems.

base.name: Framework
base.desc: A repository that manages curricula, achievement standards, and competencies as one framework. The learning data we collect and the credentials we issue point to items in this framework.

groups.name: Collection
groups.desc: Collects learning activity as standard statements and links each statement to an achievement item

groups.name: Credentials
groups.desc: Issues accumulated achievements as verifiable credentials

groups.name: Integration
groups.desc: Connects with roster, learning tool, and assessment systems
